dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: What are you doing coming over here? I don't need your help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it that you're doing, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: I'm trying to pull this sword out. Don't you get any ideas, I found it first!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: If only I could pull it out, then...

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: ...Okay so I don't know what would actually happen, but it'd definitely be something big!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Look at the rust, the angle of entry into the ground... It's perfect. It's got to be a lost sword from some legend or another, I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Armed with this sword, I... I'd probably be allowed to go on adventures with Mommy and Daddy. And I could join the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Yeah, you should go. Don't tell anyone a thing about the sword!

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Hmph, what a shame. I thought that this was my big chance, but it was all over before I could even pull the sword out.

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: If only I had, then I would have been able to defeat Stormterror. I mean, it's a sword of legend, and so I must be...

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: What? Me, scared? I was never scared, I just hadn't pulled the sword out yet!
